blocks.text: Welcome to Lio Mart.

The purpose of Lio Mart is to provide users with a simple, convenient, and transparent platform through which they may access participating e-commerce websites and, where applicable, earn Cashback, Rewards, or Referral Benefits subject to these Terms & Conditions.

blocks.text: Product Prices, Price Changes and Price Discrepancies

Lio Mart displays product prices based on the price information available from the respective Merchant, Affiliate Partner, or other authorized source at the time the product is added, listed, imported, or last updated on the Platform.

Product prices displayed on Lio Mart may not always reflect the Merchant’s current or real-time selling price. Merchants and Affiliate Partners may change, increase, decrease, or otherwise modify product prices, discounts, offers, taxes, shipping charges, or other applicable charges at any time. Due to technical, operational, synchronization, or update limitations, such changes may not be reflected on Lio Mart immediately.

Accordingly, the price displayed on Lio Mart is provided for informational and comparison purposes and should not be treated as a guaranteed or final sale price. The final price applicable to a purchase shall be the price, along with applicable taxes, shipping charges, discounts, and other charges, displayed by the respective Merchant on its website or application at the time the User places the order or completes the purchase.

Users are advised to verify the final product price, availability, applicable discounts, delivery charges, taxes, and other terms on the Merchant’s website or application before completing any purchase.

Lio Mart shall not be responsible for any difference between the price displayed on the Lio Mart Platform and the price subsequently displayed by the Merchant, nor for any loss, inconvenience, or claim arising solely from such price differences, provided that Lio Mart has not independently guaranteed the displayed price.

Any cashback, reward, commission, or other benefit, where applicable, shall be calculated and processed in accordance with the applicable Merchant/Affiliate Partner terms and Lio Mart’s Cashback and Rewards Policy, and shall not be interpreted as a guarantee of any particular product price.
